name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 1
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界vol.1
source:
Protagonist Akira Kido and his classmate were into a VR game called Fantasia.
In that world Akira was finding out the details of being a spellcaster when he met a young girl.
She ran off, so he asked a red-haired boy where she went. A blue-haired boy suddenly appeared, then those boys also ran off.
Thinking it was odd, Akira contacted the support staff and used his magic to chase after them.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE118259.html]DLsite English[/url]]
